ABOUT
Originally established in 2001 as the beloved Colonel's Quarters bed and breakfast, the property quickly became one of the region's most sought-after destinations for weddings and special events.
Today, with more than 750 celebrations hosted on-site, Castle Hill has become synonymous with timeless gatherings and beautifully curated moments.​
In 2015, Castle Hill unveiled its stunning Grand Ballroom the largest indoor event venue in Oxford. Thoughtfully designed with sophistication in mind, the 4,000-square-foot ballroom features sparkling crystal chandeliers, built-in staging and lighting, expansive patios, and an impressive 25-foot mahogany bar, creating an atmosphere that feels both luxurious and inviting.
For overnight accommodations, Castle Hill offers seven beautifully appointed guest suites across three charming buildings on the estate. While no longer operating as a traditional bed and breakfast, each room is designed to provide comfort, warmth, and a peaceful retreat for wedding parties and guests alike, complete with thoughtful touches to begin each morning with ease.​
We are honored to share Castle Hill with each guest who walks through our doors and look forward to welcoming you whether for a wedding weekend, a special celebration, or an unforgettable stay surrounded by timeless Southern elegance.

FAQs | castlehill
top of page
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
For additional questions or details, please contact our team below
CONTACT
What types of events does Castle Hill host?
Castle Hill hosts a wide range of events including weddings, receptions, galas, fundraisers, corporate gatherings, sorority and fraternity events, private celebrations, and creative productions.
Can Castle Hill be rented for private or non-event stays?
Yes. Select estate rooms are available for overnight stays and may be booked even without an event, offering a boutique-style experience on the property.
How far is Castle Hill from the Oxford Town Square?
Castle Hill is conveniently located just 5 minutes from The Square.
Is event coordination included?
Castle Hill offers venue support and event coordination details. Our in-house event coordinator, Emily, is also a full-service wedding planner and available to assist in bringing your event vision to life. Full-service planning may also be arranged through our preferred planners.
Is parking available for guests?
Yes. On-site parking is available and may be coordinated based on event size.
Are tours available before booking?
Yes. Private tours are available by appointment to explore the estate and discuss event details. Click here to book your tour.
